summary_1line: Gods oppressed by Sukesha’s Rakshasa sons seek Shiva, who directs them to Vishnu; Vishnu promises battle as Rakshasas march from Lanka amid ominous portents.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vishnu, clad in yellow and blazing like a thousand suns, mounts Garuda with conch, discus, mace, sword, and bow as celestial beings praise him.
Terrible omens appear as rain of blood and bones falls from the clouds while jackals howl and mountains tremble before the Rakshasa march.
The vast Rakshasa army rides out of Lanka on bizarre mounts—serpents, lions, whales, birds and elephants—advancing toward Devaloka.
